title: The Serial Killer Who Left 'Recipes' for Cooking His Victims in Victim Kitchens

why_this_can_go_viral: Extremely dark, bizarre, and psychologically complex—the 'why' question haunts viewers. Highly shareable for true crime communities.

title: The Billion-Dollar Fraud That Sold 'Fake Citizenship' to the World's Richest Fugitives
hook: A company forged passports from a non-existent island nation, sold them for $2M each, and 47 fugitives lived freely—until the island was revealed as a Photoshop file.
